verdict.rationale: LiveKit ships as a headless server you can deploy as a single binary, in Docker or on Kubernetes, with a `--dev` mode that uses a placeholder key pair. Its own CLI can access server APIs, create tokens, generate test traffic, and scaffold and deploy agents, all of which are scriptable. Nothing in the evidence explicitly documents CI usage, though. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), documented non-interactive or CI auth flows for the CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
